new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Job Title: Plant Manager**

**Job Type: On-Site**

**Location: Orange, CA**

**Reporting to: VP of Manufacturing**

**Company Overview**

FXI is a leading producer of foam innovation in the Bedding, Furniture, Industrial, Home & Office, Healthcare, and Transportation markets. We have made it our mission to provide tailored solutions that delight our customers and consumers. With our corporate headquarters, high-tech research and development facility, and multiple manufacturing locations in North America, FXI has built a culture of innovation and achievement that is recognized by customers, suppliers and peers. Our products include finished goods, sub-assemblies, services, and raw materials for OEMs, fabricators, and retailers. You will find FXI's foam innovations inside, around, and under yourself in countless applications. Everywhere foam goes, FXI's innovations lead the way! Won't you join us?

**Job Overview:**

Reporting to the Manufacturing Vice President, the Plant Manager plans, directs, and coordinates the operations of the plant. The Plant Manager has leadership responsibility to assure compliance with all government and company policies and procedures. This position will also be responsible for facility production goals and objectives. Following FXI's Vision, Mission and Values, the Plant Manager is to develop a well-trained and motivated staff with emphasis on plant safety and employee engagement.

**Responsibilities:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Chemical, or related discipline) preferred.

* Direct and coordinate plant operations in strict compliance with all state and federal laws, regulations, corporate policies and procedures
* Responsible for achieving all facility business goals including, but not limited to, the areas of safety, quality, production, reliability and P&L.

* Maintain a clean and safe plant; incorporate a 5S culture for conducting all work activities.

* Develop and foster a high‑performing, well‑trained, and motivated workforce by assessing current skill sets and aligning talent development with the plant's future growth, vision, and manufacturing excellence across all functions.

* Lead the development, implementation, and governance of plant performance metrics and KPIs to monitor progress toward site objectives and drive continuous improvement.

* Conduct and assure all required employee development and performance reviews are completed to promote individual continuous improvement per the required corporate schedule.

* Attend scheduled corporate training and meetings. Need to be a key leader moving the company forward to meet strategic and business plan objectives.
* Ensures that all plant assets are properly managed, safeguarded, and secure.

* Develop, submit for approval, and implement approved Capital Projects as required to meet facility strategic plans and business needs.

* Develop and ensure management systems are in place to monitor plant output, cuts / yields and scrap to ensure efficient resource utilization and initiate corrective action as required.

* Establish and maintain a positive community relationship.

**Qualifications:**

* 10 years of prior experience in a manufacturing environment
* Prior experience as Production / Operations Manager.
* Strong interpersonal, problem solving and leadership skills with the ability to lead a team motivate the group and manage a diverse workforce.
* Excellent, engaging communicator; able to set measurable goals and expectations and hold team members accountable for results

* Demonstrated experience and working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles and structured problem‑solving tools (e.g., 5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, Root Cause Analysis, A3, 5 Whys) to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.

* Action-oriented and eager to drive programs through to completion. Able to deal with pressures and timelines inherent in a fast-paced company
* Ability to quickly assess the situation at the plant and have an impact on the direction of improvements
* Ability to function as a strong leader, bringing the Operations perspective while promoting cross-functional horizontal alignment to achieve key company goals
* Hands-on leader who contributes to overall business strategy and issues, works well as part of the leadership team, and is focused upon achieving results
* Team player and coach who will promote cooperation among employees in the organization and an environment of employee engagement
* Possess the confidence and presence to be able to deal effectively with external customers, vendors, and all levels within the organization
* Strong, self-confident, decisive leader with excellent listening skills, emotional maturity, and ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment

**Our Commitment to a Diverse Workforce:** FXI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. FXI does not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or based on any individual's membership in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. We support workplace diversity. We strongly believe that diversity contributes to a broader collective perspective that will consistently lead to a better company and better products. We are working hard to increase the diversity of our team wherever we can.

***We are interested in every*** ***qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.***

FXI is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at FXI via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of FXI. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by FXI as a result of the referral or through other means.

new_roles.title: VP, Manufacturing - Fresh Bakery
new_roles.description:
**Since 1869, we've connected people through food they love. We’re proud to be stewards of amazing brands that people trust. Our portfolio includes the iconic Campbell’s brand, as well as Cape Cod, Chunky, Goldfish, Kettle Brand, Lance, Late July, Pacific Foods, Pepperidge Farm, Prego, Pace, Rao’s Homemade, Snack Factory, Snyder’s of Hanover. Swanson, and V8.**

**Here, you will make a difference every day. You will be supported to build a rewarding career with opportunities to grow, innovate and inspire. Make history with us.**

**Why Campbell’s…**

* Benefits begin on day one and include medical, dental, short and long-term disability, AD&D, and life insurance (for individual, families, and domestic partners).
* Employees are eligible for our matching 401(k) plan and can enroll on the first day of employment with immediate vesting.
* Campbell’s offers unlimited sick time along with paid time off and holiday pay.
* If in WHQ – free access to the fitness center. Access to on-site day care (operated by Bright Horizons) and company store.
* Giving back to the communities where our employees work and live is very important to Campbell’s. Our “Campbell’s Cares” program matches employee donations and/or volunteer activity up to $1,500 annually.
* Campbell’s has a variety of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support employees.

**Job Description**

The Vice President, Manufacturing – Fresh Bakery provides strategic and operational leadership for Campbell’s Fresh Bakery manufacturing network, including bakery operations in Bloomfield, Connecticut; Downers Grove, Illinois; Lakeland, Florida; and Denver, Pennsylvania. This leader establishes the manufacturing strategy, operating priorities, performance expectations, and transformation agenda for the network, ensuring consistent execution across safety, quality, service, cost, reliability, productivity, and people.

Leading through the Plant Managers, the VP creates alignment across sites while maintaining clear site-level accountability for day-to-day operations and results. The role builds manufacturing capability and organizational talent across the network, identifies and addresses systemic performance opportunities, and drives continuous improvement and transformation to strengthen the long-term competitiveness of the Fresh Bakery business.

This leader partners across Supply Chain and the broader organization to align manufacturing strategy, capabilities, capacity, capital priorities, and resources with business needs. The incumbent must be an enterprise-minded business partner who creates direction, enables effective decisions, builds talent and culture, drives disciplined execution, and owns results across the network.

**Essential Job Duties**

**Manufacturing Strategy & Network Leadership:** Define and lead the multi-year manufacturing strategy for the Fresh Bakery network. Translate business and Supply Chain priorities into clear site objectives, integrated roadmaps, operating plans, and performance expectations. Maintain clarity between network-level strategic direction and Plant Manager ownership of daily site operations.

**Safety, Quality & Operating Integrity:** Set expectations and governance for employee safety, food safety, product quality, environmental responsibility, and regulatory compliance across all bakery sites. Ensure effective management systems, standards, controls, and escalation routines are in place, while holding Plant Managers accountable for site execution and results.

**Network Performance Management & Accountability:** Establish the operating cadence and performance-management system for safety, quality, service, cost, labor, yield, waste, reliability, customer service, and employee engagement. Review performance across sites, identify systemic gaps and best practices, define corrective actions, and ensure clear ownership and follow-through.

**Manufacturing Transformation & Operational Excellence:** Lead the transformation agenda for Fresh Bakery manufacturing, creating consistent operating systems, standards, and management routines across the network. Build a culture of continuous improvement and zero loss, and use Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance, equipment reliability, and problem-solving disciplines to deliver sustainable improvements.

**Cost, Productivity & Business Performance:** Deliver network productivity, cost, waste, and efficiency commitments through disciplined planning and execution. Connect operational performance to financial outcomes, evaluate trade-offs, and mobilize cross-site resources to address significant performance gaps or opportunities.

**Capacity, Capability & Capital Strategy:** Shape network capacity, capability, technology, and capital priorities based on demand, growth, service, risk, and long-term business needs. Sponsor major capital and capability initiatives, ensure disciplined prioritization and governance, and partner with Engineering and other functions to achieve intended business outcomes.

**Talent, Leadership & Culture%:** Build a strong and diverse manufacturing leadership pipeline across the Fresh Bakery network. Coach and develop Plant Managers and senior site leaders; strengthen succession, bench strength, workforce planning, engagement, and retention; and create a high-performing culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

**Cross-Functional & Enterprise Partnership:** Partner with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Research & Development, Commercial, Finance, People & Culture, and other stakeholders to align priorities, solve network constraints, support innovation and commercialization, manage risk, and deliver enterprise outcomes. Serve as the senior manufacturing voice for the Fresh Bakery business.

**Required Education & Skills**

· Bachelor's degree strongly preferred or an Associate's degree with significant experience.

· Fresh Bakery manufacturing experience strongly preferred

· 15+ years of progressive manufacturing/operations experience

· Prior experience as a Plant Manager, General Manager, Director of Site Operations, or comparable senior manufacturing leader

· Significant people leadership experience, including leadership of senior operational leaders

· Demonstrated manufacturing leadership experience

· Multi-site leadership experience, likely something I'd make required or strongly preferred

**Preferred Experienc** e

· Multi-site manufacturing leadership experience, including leadership through Plant Managers or comparable senior site leaders.

· Experience in food manufacturing or consumer packaged goods (CPG) within a complex, high-volume manufacturing network.

· Demonstrated experience leading large-scale manufacturing transformation and operational excellence, with a track record of driving sustainable improvements in safety, quality, service, cost, reliability, and productivity.

· Experience applying Lean Manufacturing, Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), reliability, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies at scale.

· Experience developing manufacturing network strategy, including capacity, asset utilization, capital investment, and long-term capability planning.

· Demonstrated experience developing senior manufacturing leaders and building succession and bench strength across multiple operations.

· Experience managing significant operating budgets, productivity commitments, capital investments, and/or P&L responsibility.

· Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to work across Planning, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Procurement, Finance, Commercial, R&D, and People & Culture to deliver business outcomes.

· Advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.

**Physical Requirements**

This role requires regular work in manufacturing environments and a visible presence across bakery facilities, including walking, standing, climbing stairs, and accessing production, warehouse, and office areas. The incumbent must be able to wear required personal protective equipment and work a flexible schedule as business needs require.

**Travel**

This role requires **at least 75% travel** , primarily to Campbell’s Fresh Bakery manufacturing sites and Headquarters. Regular and sustained on-site presence is expected to provide visible leadership, build strong partnerships with Plant Managers and site leadership teams, understand operating conditions firsthand, and support execution of manufacturing priorities and transformation initiatives

 

**Compensation and Benefits:**

The target base salary range for this full-time, salaried position is between

$221,500-$304,600

Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. Total pay may include other forms of compensation. In addition, we offer competitive health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. Please ask your Talent Acquisition Partner for more information about our total rewards package.

**The Company is committed to providing equal opportunity for employees and qualified applicants in all aspects of the employment relationship, including consideration for employment, without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, marital status, protected veteran status, disability, age, religion, or any other classification protected by law.**

new_roles.description:
**Work Location** :

New York, New York, United States of America

**Hours:**

40

**Line of Business:**

TD Securities

**Pay Detail:**

$225,000 - $225,000 USD

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

**Job Description:**

Conducts a range of comprehensive analysis and research on individual corporations, industries, financial markets and/or economic developments to support business needs and publish high quality research reports/presentations aligned to industries and various markets. Also provides critical insights and industry information to support advisory services.

 

**Depth & Scope:**

* Highly seasoned professional role requiring substantial knowledge / expertise in a complex field and knowledge of broader related areas
* Takes a lead role in modeling and interpretation of advanced insights within research reports
* Integrates knowledge of sub-function's overarching strategy in developing solutions across multiple functions or operations
* Interprets internal/external business challenges and the industry environment, recommends course of action and best practices to improve products, processes, or services
* Solves or may lead others to solve complex problems; leads efforts or partners with others to develop new solutions
* Uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgement and identify solutions
* Communicates difficult concepts; converts information to compelling business context and advice; influences and gains alignment across increasingly senior stakeholders
* Acts as a technical expert / lead integrating cross-functional knowledge, impacting the achievement of business objectives
* Work is guided by policies and industry standards/methods
Works autonomously as the lead and guide others within area of expertise 

 

**Education & Experience:**

* Undergraduate degree
* Masters or PhD preferred
* CFA designation preferred for publishing analysts and associates
5+ years related experience 

 

**Customer Accountabilities:**

* Works closely with the sales and trading group to develop new relationships, and with other analysts and associates to provide ongoing guidance
* Develops and maintains contacts and relationships in the community and with institutional clients
* Leads in the compilation and evaluation of multiple data inputs for:
 + Companies/industries and/or
 + Financial markets and economic analysis research reports (e.g., initiating coverage reports, thematic reports, quarterly reporting initiatives, and marketing packages)
* Publishes high quality, comprehensive analysis and research on industry sectors and companies and/or financial markets and economic development
* Develops business relationships and generates profits from producing and sharing regular research publications
Provides service to clients (internal and external) in the form of information, expertise, analysis, and opinions regarding market information, financial markets, economic outlook, and investment strategies 

 

**Shareholder Accountabilities:**

* Keeps abreast of market data, economic information, and key industry developments, as well as internal policies and regulatory standards (as communicated by Compliance) at all times to assist in maximizing profitability through sound and well-informed decisions; develop and maintain contacts with market participants
* Demonstrates governance, control, and risk management behaviors in alignment with TD policies and practices
* Adheres to enterprise frameworks or methodologies that relate to activities for our business area
* Ensures respective programs/policies/practices are well managed, meets business needs, complies with internal and external requirements, and aligns with business priorities
* Consistently exercises discretion in managing correspondence, information, and all matters of confidentiality; escalate issues where appropriate
* Participates in cross-functional/enterprise initiatives as a subject matter expert helping to identify risk/provide guidance for complex situations
* Conducts internal and external research projects; support the development/delivery of presentations and communications to management or broader audience
* Conducts meaningful analysis at the functional or enterprise level using results to draw conclusions, make recommendations, assess the effectiveness of programs/policies/practices
* Monitors service, productivity, and assess efficiency levels within own function and implement continuous process/performance improvements where opportunities exist
* Actively manages relationships within and across various business lines, corporate, and/or control functions and ensures alignment with enterprise and/or regulatory requirements

new_roles.title: Manufacturing Engineering Director, Site
new_roles.description:
**Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities.**

GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.6bn in 2025. There are no limits to where you can take your career.

**Job Summary**
---------------

As a member of the site leadership team the Site Head of ME role is accountable for delivering Manufacturing Engineering solutions to the Programs and Operations organizations. This will include creating a Zero Defect culture through the application of the Zero Defect Manufacturing (ZDM) tool suite to ensure industry leading quality performance, guaranteeing on time delivery. The role will also be accountable for delivering year on year conversion cost productivity targets in collaboration with the site leadership team.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Exemplifying a safety-first mindset and ensuring compliance with the GKN Aerospace Health, Safety and Environmental policies and standards.
* Building and leading a high performance, multi-disciplined Manufacturing Engineering organization encompassing the whole ME perimeter including Facilities & Maintenance. This includes managing talent selection, training, development, engagement, ongoing performance and succession planning.
* Budgetary ownership for the site Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities & Maintenance team.
* Accountable for delivering annual quality improvement targets for the site, enabling year on year conversion cost target realization.
* Accountable for delivering Facilities & Maintenance performance results in accordance with Site Budget and Strategic Plan.
* Developing the Zero Defects Manufacturing (ZDM) mindset and culture into the site Manufacturing Engineering organisation through implementation of standard ZDM tool suite and APQP process.
* Developing close relationships with Program teams to deliver manufacturing engineering solutions in line with customer requirements and expectations.
* Accountable for sustaining and improving Program & Product manufacturing engineering systems in line with business case expectations.

**Job Qualifications**
----------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or related Engineering discipline and demonstrated technical expertise in Manufacturing Engineering.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive Manufacturing Engineering experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience overseeing engineering teams within a regulated manufacturing environment (e.g., aerospace, defense, automotive, medical device, or similar industries).
* Experience managing new product introduction (NPI), process industrialization, and continuous improvement initiatives within a manufacturing environment.
* Ability to influence stakeholders, build trust, and establish effective working relationships within a global organization.
* Working knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles and practices.Working knowledge of quality management systems such as ISO 9001, AS9100, or equivalent.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
* Must be a U.S. Person, as defined by ITAR, to comply with export control requirements.
 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Project / Program Management
* Familiarity with AS9145 APQP process or equivalent
* Advanced Business degree
* Prepared to travel domestically and occasionally internationally; Expected travel <5% of year.
* GKN Aerospace experience

We’ll offer you fantastic challenges and amazing opportunities. This is your chance to be part of an organisation that has proven itself to be at the cutting edge of our industry; and is committed to pushing the boundaries even further. And with some of the best training on offer in the industry, who knows how far you can go?

**A Great Place to work needs a Great Way of Working**

Everyone is welcome to apply to GKN. We believe that we can only achieve our ambitions through a coming together of diverse minds who enjoy collaborating in an inspirational environment. Through our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging and by living our five powerful principles we’ve created a culture where everyone feels welcome to contribute. It’s a culture that won us ‘The Best Workplace Culture Award’. By embracing and celebrating what makes us unique we encourage everyone to bring their full self to work.

We’re also committed to providing an accessible recruitment process, so if you require reasonable adjustments at any stage during our recruitment process please get in touch and let us know.

We are the place where human dreams, plus human endeavour, shape the future of aerospace innovation and technology.

new_roles.title: Director of Manufacturing Operations
new_roles.description:
Airlite Plastics is a premier, privately held, family-owned manufacturer headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska. Our family style and personal culture is what makes Airlite an amazing place to grow and build a successful career. Airlite’s company values of unquestionable integrity and respect and appreciation for each other are at the core of our success! These values set a strong foundation to build on where we can ‘wow’ our customers with innovative products and sustainable solutions and continuously improve our processes and efficiencies.

 

Our product lines include rigid plastic containers and lids for food packaging and cosmetics, dry powder scoops, plastic drink cups, shipping containers, industrial strength insulated concrete forms (ICF) and sustainable permeable paving systems. As pioneers in our industry, focused on sustainable solutions, we strive to provide our customers with top-notch service and quality, which aligns with our award-winning products.

 

As Airlite continues to grow and expand, we are excited to add new roles across our organization to support increasing customer demand and future innovation. This is an exciting time to join our team and be part of a company investing in people, technology, and long-term success.

 

**How would you contribute?**

This role is a contributing member of our team located in Nazareth, PA. As a Director of Operations you are a key to continued growth and success of Airlite. The Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for manufacturing operations across assigned Airlite Locations. This role is responsible for Production, Maintenance, and Engineering and ensures operational strategies, resources, and priorities are aligned with business objectives.

This role will drive operational excellence through strong leadership, development of site leadership teams, continuous improvement, effective use of performance metrics, and disciplined execution. A key focus of this position is building leadership capability throughout the organization by coaching and developing managers and supervisors as the operations continue to grow and evolve. The Director will balance consistent operational expectations across locations while recognizing the unique needs and autonomy of each facility.

**Essential Duties:**

* Provide strategic leadership and direction for Production, Maintenance, and Engineering across the Nazareth and Lakeville facilities.

* Lead, coach, and develop operational leaders, strengthening leadership capability, accountability, decision-making, and succession readiness throughout the organization.

* Establish operational priorities, goals, and KPIs and use performance data to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

* Ensure manufacturing operations consistently achieve objectives related to safety, quality, delivery, productivity, efficiency, and cost.

* Partner with site leadership to develop and execute operational plans that support business growth, capacity requirements, equipment needs, and organizational objectives.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve manufacturing processes, equipment reliability, labor effectiveness, throughput, and overall operational performance.

* Provide leadership for capital projects, equipment installations, process improvements, and other operational initiatives in partnership with Engineering and Maintenance.

* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing, and leadership needs and develop teams capable of supporting current operations and future growth.

* Promote consistency and sharing of best practices between facilities while allowing each operation to respond effectively to its specific business and manufacturing needs.

* Partner cross-functionally with Quality, Supply Chain, Safety, Human Resources, Finance, Sales, Customer Service, and other functions to resolve issues and achieve business objectives.

* Develop and manage operational budgets, forecasts, capital requirements, and resource plans in alignment with financial and strategic objectives.

* Foster a culture of safety, accountability, collaboration, employee development, continuous improvement, and operational excellence while exemplifying Airlite's Core Values and servant leadership principles.

* Other duties as assigned.

 

**Do you have what it takes?** Airlite Plastics is a versatile employer; complacency is not one of our strengths! We work hard each day to ensure that equipment efficiency and customer satisfaction never leave our line of sight. Successful candidates for the role will possess the following:

 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, Manufacturing, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including significant responsibility for manufacturing operations.
* 5+ years of experience leading managers and/or senior operational leaders.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing multiple operational functions such as Production, Maintenance, and Engineering.
* Experience leading operations across multiple facilities or business units strongly preferred.
* Experience with capital planning, operational budgeting, continuous improvement, and manufacturing performance management.
* Plastics manufacturing, injection molding, extrusion, or related manufacturing experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop managers and emerging leaders.
* Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to understand the impact of operational decisions on overall business performance.
* Ability to effectively lead across multiple facilities, balancing consistent operational expectations with the unique needs of each location.
* Capability to solve complex problems, utilizing strong critical thinking and decision-making skills
* Superior organizational skills and the ability to assemble resources needed to orchestrate multiple projects/activities and accomplish goals
* Model a collaborative leadership style with the ability to build partnerships and influence others into action
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills
* Outstanding presentation and facilitation skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills and consultative approach; tactful in dealing with people at all levels
* Strong sense of urgency, self-motivated and positive
* Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations
* Ability to actively lead change initiatives
* Display highest ethical standards
* Maintain the utmost level of confidentiality in dealing with sensitive information
* Detail oriented, with the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment

 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; stand; walk; use hand dexterity to operate office equipment including computer keyboards; reach with hands and arms; and talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be exposed to moving mechanical parts. The noise level in the office work environment is typically quiet; when visiting the production floor, the noise level may be loud.

 

**Our Core Values Drive Us!**

 

* Do you conduct yourself with unquestionable integrity?

* Do you demonstrate respect and appreciation for those around you?

* Are you innovative and strive to challenge the status quo?

* Do you strive for continuous improvement and to deliver the “wow” factor?

* Do you care about environmentally sustainable solutions?

* Do you take meaning and pride in a job well done?

 

**What’s in it for you?** ***As a Full-Time employee, you will be eligible for the following benefits:***

 

* Health, dental and vision insurance

* Company paid life insurance

* Company paid short term disability

* Generous 401k match

* Generous Time Off

* Annual company activities

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**LOCATION**: Currently tied to Morrisville, NC (may be open to other locations). Relocation assistance is NOT provided.

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
* Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.

**DESCRIPTION**:

As a Senior Director of Operations at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll manage complex manufacturing operations while driving strategic growth and operational excellence. This key leadership role involves directing production of high-quality products in regulated environments while ensuring exceptional customer service and compliance. You'll optimize end-to-end operations, implement continuous improvement initiatives, and develop high-performing teams aligned with our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

Working closely with cross-functional partners, you'll establish and execute strategic plans, drive productivity and efficiency improvements, and support a culture focused on quality, safety and customer success. This role requires strong business acumen to manage P&L responsibilities while scaling operations to meet growing demand. You'll support our PPI (Practical Process Improvement) business system and 4i values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - while developing talent and building engaged, collaborative teams.

**REQUIREMENTS**:

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in operations leadership in regulated manufacturing environments
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering, Chemistry, Biology, Business or related technical/scientific field
* Advanced training in continuous improvement methodologies (Six Sigma, Lean)
* Demonstrated P&L management and operational excellence experience at scale
* Strong working knowledge of cGMP, FDA, and other relevant quality/regulatory requirements
* Experience leading and developing large, multi-functional teams
* Experience implementing continuous improvement and lean manufacturing methodologies
* Strong business acumen and analytical capabilities
* Effective communication and influence skills across all organizational levels
* Ability to implement change and deliver results in matrix environments
* Experience with ERP systems and manufacturing technologies
* Strong project management capabilities
* Strategic mindset with ability to balance short and long-term priorities
* Experience in customer/client relationship management
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
* Ability to travel 50-75% as required
* Change management and transformation experience
* Cross-functional collaboration and influence skills

**Company Description**

Table 87 Frozen LLC is a national frozen pizza manufacturer and “The Home Of The Coal Oven Slice.” Born in Brooklyn NY, founder Thomas Cucco opened his first slice shop in Brooklyn Heights in 2012. Today, Table 87 runs three authentic coal-oven pizza shops while operating its own vertically integrated frozen production facility that ships its signature frozen pizza nationwide. After national exposure on ABC’s Shark Tank, Table 87 has scaled into top retailers and distributors across the USA, bringing authentic Brooklyn NY coal-oven pizza to freezers everywhere.

**Role Description**

The Director of Operations, Frozen is a full-time, on-site role based in Brooklyn, NY. This role will own day-to-day operations of the Frozen Production Facility and drive consistent output across all frozen manufacturing. Core responsibilities include production leadership, packaging, staffing, inventory and supply-chain optimization, logistics expertise, food-safety elevation, and full facility/equipment readiness. Our mandate is clear: take a high-growth disruptor brand’s production operation and turn it into a dominant, scalable food-manufacturing engine. Success in this role is designed to evolve into COO.

**Qualifications**

* Proven track record evolving an emerging brand into advanced, large-scale manufacturing success

new_roles.title: Project Director, Aseptic Operations
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

**New to North Carolina. Known for pursuing breakthroughs in medicine.**

**Ready to join our team?**

At AbbVie, we bring together talented people and innovative science to develop medicines that help patients. Now, we’re bringing that commitment to Durham, North Carolina, with a new manufacturing campus that will expand our ability to produce medicines and create opportunities in the Research Triangle.

The campus will integrate advanced manufacturing, laboratory technologies and AI to support the production of immunology, oncology and neuroscience medicines. The first phase will include manufacturing facilities, next-generation laboratories, a warehouse, administrative offices and employee wellness facilities.

To learn more about this investment, please visit https://www.abbvie.com/abbvie-north-carolina-manufacturing.html

We are now recruiting our **Project Director, Aseptic Operations as part of the core start up leadership team**.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Aseptic Suite Delivery and Accountability:** Lead delivery of aseptic manufacturing suites across multiple modalities, partnering with Project Delivery and global engineering SMEs. Own delivery against approved scope, schedule, budget, and design and construction quality expectations.
* **Equipment Package and Team Leadership:** Lead, coach, and guide package leads responsible for filling machines, isolators, lyophilizers, stopper processors, AVI, autoclaves, and washers. Establish clear accountabilities, align priorities, and resolve issues across equipment packages.
* **Manufacturing Representation and Decision-Making:** Represent Manufacturing throughout the project lifecycle, providing operational requirements and timely decisions. Ensure design choices and equipment acceptance support safe, high-quality, and practical manufacturing operations.
* **Advanced Manufacturing Technology:** Lead implementation of automation, robotics, data analysis, and digital twins within the manufacturing suites. Align technology decisions with operational needs and ensure the manufacturing team is prepared to use the capabilities introduced.
* **Construction Quality and Technical Acceptance:** Partner with Construction and Engineering to ensure suite quality and workmanship meet agreed standards. Provide manufacturing leadership during equipment testing and acceptance at vendor facilities and on site, driving resolution of issues affecting operational readiness.
* **Commissioning, Qualification, and Start-Up Readiness:** Partner with project and commissioning teams to commission and qualify equipment, facilities, and systems. Lead manufacturing procedure development and readiness activities to support the transition from project delivery into operations.
* **Organization Building and Capability Development:** Build the manufacturing organization as start-up and qualification activities accelerate. Define resource needs, recruit and onboard team members, and establish training and development to prepare the team for operational responsibilities.
* **Transition to Aseptic Operations Leadership:** Transition from project delivery into aseptic operations leadership, maintaining continuity of ownership and knowledge. Establish a high-performing manufacturing organization with clear accountability and the highest standards of employee safety and product quality.
* **Aseptic Practices, Contamination Control, and Quality Culture:** Establish operational ownership of aseptic practices and contamination-control expectations. Partner with Quality, Engineering, Validation, and Microbiology/Environmental Monitoring to align the manufacturing operating model with the contamination control strategy
* **Operational Readiness and Manufacturing Organization:** Own Manufacturing Operational Readiness from design through commissioning, qualification, start-up, and routine operations. Build and lead the manufacturing organization, defining staffing, shift strategy, accountabilities across production leadership, frontline supervision, and support functions, SOPs, operating procedures, and manufacturing business processes. Develop capability through structured onboarding, technical training, qualification, and leadership development.
* **Manufacturing Performance and Supply Reliability:** Establish performance expectations for safety, quality, schedule adherence, throughput, yield, equipment reliability, and operating efficiency. Develop production strategies for the intended product mix and multi-product operating model. Partner with Supply Chain, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, and Technical Operations to resolve constraints and improve line performance while balancing GMP compliance, supply reliability, capacity, cost, and operational flexibility.

 
**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, pharmaceutical sciences, manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

**Experience**

* At least 15 years of aseptic operations experience in a cGMP biopharmaceutical industry with extensive floor leadership.
* Solid track record of leading high-performance manufacturing teams with an exceptional safety and quality performance.
* Experience in roles that supported capital project delivery, C&Q, start-up and forming operational teams is preferred.
* Extensive, progressively responsible experience in aseptic manufacturing, engineering, including leadership of complex manufacturing equipment or facility programs.
* Hands-on leadership experience across equipment design reviews, vendor and site acceptance testing, commissioning, qualification, and manufacturing start-up.
* Experience building and developing teams, establishing manufacturing procedures and training, and preparing an organization for operational readiness.
* Experience implementing advanced manufacturing technologies and translating project delivery knowledge into sustainable operational capability.

**Skills**

* **Strategic and execution leadership:** Ability to connect project delivery decisions with long-term manufacturing needs while maintaining accountability for results.
* **Aseptic manufacturing expertise:** Strong understanding of aseptic process equipment, suite integration, and operational safety and quality requirements.
* **Cross-functional influence:** Ability to align Manufacturing, Engineering, Project Delivery, Construction, commissioning teams, and equipment vendors around timely decisions.
* **Technical judgment and problem-solving:** Ability to evaluate complex equipment and facility issues, assess delivery and operational impacts, and drive resolution.
* **People leadership:** Strong coaching, recruitment, resource planning, and capability-development skills.
* **Digital and technology fluency:** Ability to guide implementation of automation, robotics, data analysis, and digital twins in manufacturing.
* **Communication and transition leadership:** Ability to communicate priorities and decisions clearly and lead teams from project execution through start-up into routine operations.

 **Additional Information**

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law:

* The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.
* We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
* This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

new_roles.title: Director of Chemistry, Small Molecule Process Development and Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**About This Role**
 
We are seeking a highly motivated and creative Director of Chemistry to join our Small Molecule Chemical Development team. In this role, you will lead and mentor scientific and engineering teams as you guide project progression from early-phase through late-phase drug development. You will oversee the design and refinement of robust manufacturing processes for a wide range of small molecules, supporting pre - clinical and clinical therapeutics. This role is integral to advancing our scientific endeavors, driving innovation, and enabling the successful launch of new medicines through collaborative, safe, economical, and sustainable process development.

**Who We Are**

We are a team of organic chemists and chemical engineers engaged in the design of innovative processes which supply new medicines to patients. We focus on developing safe, economical, sustainable, cost - effective , and robust processes to support clinical trials and the launch of new medicines across various drug modalities. We are driven by first principles science, data-driven decision-making, and collaborative teamwork.

**What** **You’ll****Do**

* Lead c ollaborat ive development and manufacturing teams to design and conduct experiments to optimize and characterize the processes of Biogen assets with an emphasis on improvement in process understanding, robustness, and productivity.

* D esign, guide and execute experimental plans to advance the Biogen portfolio. You will be responsible for leading project teams towards the implementation of safe, efficient and robust chemical processes Biogen drug candidates. You will c ollaborate with development and manufacturing teams to optimize and characterize the processes of Biogen assets with an emphasis on improvement in process understanding, robustness, and productivity.

* Responsible for managing scientific colleagues, and mentoring, engaging, and preparing our future scientific and engineering leaders

* Develop the fundamental process knowledge needed to support the transition of chemical and biochemical processes from laboratory scale to manufacturing partners.

* Collaborate with our Process Engineering, Analytical Chemistry, Oligo Synthesis, Solid Form, and Separations colleagues to develop the knowledge and controls needed for the supply of clinical materials and characterization of processes to support regulatory filings.

* Communicate project team research results effectively by in reports and discussions in team meetings , including e ngage ment in CMC activities including authoring CMC section of INDs.

* Interact with Contract Research Organizations as project needs evolve , which may include travel

* Initiate innovative research projects to improve fundamental understanding and control of Biogen processes

* Expand on your Chemistry community presence professionally representing Biogen externally in consortia and conferences

**Who You Are**

You have a passion for exploring scientific concepts and are eager to contribute to the design and development and execution of cutting-edge technologies in the service of delivering drug cand idates for clinical trials . Your vision and dedication drive you to push the boundaries of scientific endeavors, ultimately impacting patient lives. You thrive in a collaborative environment where urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity are shared value s .

* M.S. or PhD with 12 + years of relevant experience , including people management, in pharmaceutical or biotech settings is required

* Strong background in the theory and practice of pharmaceutical process chemistry and engineering , including command of synthetic strategies, impurity controls, analytical, purification and isolation techniques, process characterization , familiarity with process safety and tech transfer protocols, and good problem -s olving skills in the service of delivering non-clinical and clinical APIs and the phase appropriate knowledge packages for CMC support.

* Demonstrated experience in leading project teams involved in delivery of APIs across several modalities

* Ability to lead teams ethically, collaboratively , effectively, and cross-functionally

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required along with the desire to work in a highly collaborative team environment .

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in engaging with external partners and representing the organization in external facing settings.

* Familiarity with regulatory requirements and CMC activities related to drug development.

 
Job Level: Management 

**Additional Information**

The base compensation range for this role is: $188,000.00-$258,500.00 

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.

 

Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.

 
 

In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families *physical, financial, emotional,* and *social well-being* ; including, but not limited to:

* Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
* Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
* Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
* A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
* Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
* 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
* Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
* 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
* Employee stock purchase plan
* Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
* Employee Resource Groups participation
 

 

**Why Biogen?**

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.

 
 

At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired.

 
 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, religion, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. Biogen is an E-Verify Employer in the United States.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager Job
new_roles.description:
Arkema's Birdsboro, PA site is seeking a Plant Manager (PM) with a proven track record of change management, people leadership and continuous improvement. The PM has direct responsibility for the overall operation of the Birdsboro plant. This position is responsible for the Birdsboro sites Replacement Asset Value (RAV) of approximately $120 million (original purchase cost of approximately $65 million), Replacement Plant Earnings (RPE) of approximately $12 million, annual variable costs exceeding $75 million (including monomers), and annual CAPEX of $4-5 million.

This position has 6 direct reports, each in a site leadership role and indirect responsibility for all other hourly and salaried employees. Birdsboro is a union site.

The PM has full P/L responsibility and provides leadership, direction, and management for all aspects of the plant’s manufacturing operations. The PM assists in the creation of the organization’s vision and growth strategies and executes the business and operations plans to achieve revenue, profit, and performance targets while continuing the plant’s record of success and high levels of safety and customer service.. 
 
The Plant Manager directly supports Plant Staff to manage activities and lead continued improvement in the areas of Operations, Maintenance, Human Resources, Engineering, Accounting, Purchasing, Quality, and Laboratories. The PM possesses a strong, working knowledge of and ensures compliance with; external regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and internal policies and procedures (specifically capital, accounting, purchasing, and HES).
 
 
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities with % Breakdown:** 
Safety and Environment – 20% 
HSE responsibilities include but are not restricted to those outlined in Leadership expectations such as reporting any incident in a timely manner. 

* Ensures plant is in full compliance with Arkema guidance and directives along with all applicable regulations.
* Foster a culture of Safety as a core plant value.
* Directly participates in core Arkema programs such as BBS.

Operations – 50% 
Ensures that safe operating procedures and practices are in place and followed. Ensures that mechanical integrity of all plants is maintained or improved to allow safe and efficient operation. Ensures that the plant produces at volumes to meet demand requirements set forth in S&OP plans. Ensures that adequate training is provided for a safe and efficient plant operations. 
Human Resources – 10% 
Works with site HR to see that employee activities related to hiring, promotion, layoff, salary, etc. are handled professionally. Provides an atmosphere for open communication between all employees. 
Financial–10% 
Directly accountable to prepare various budgets (fixed, variable and capex) then monitors and controls to ensure these budgets are met. 
Others: 10% 
o Communication: direct contact with both internal and external stakeholders 

* Mentoring/Coaching: Develop close working relationships with plant personnel and places a strong focus on improving both individual and team performance supporting programs such as SMART

**Minimum Qualifications and Education Required** 
Min Years of Experience 

* Minimum of 15 years of progressive manufacturing experience in plant operations, process design, and engineering, preferably in both a large and small-size integrated process manufacturing company

Education and area of focus 

* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering required.

 
Certifications/Trainings: 
Lean or Six Sigma certification preferred

**Employee Type:**

**Job Posting Title:**

Plant Manager

**About Us:**

TreeHouse Foods is a leading manufacturer of private label packaged foods and beverages, operating a network of over 20 production facilities and several corporate offices across the United States and Canada. At TreeHouse Foods, our commitment to excellence extends beyond our products and revolves around our people. We are investing in talent and creating a performance-based culture where employees can do their best work and develop their careers, directly impacting our mission to make high quality, affordable food for our customers, communities, and families. We hope you will consider joining the team and being part of our future.

Named one of America’s Best Large Employers by Forbes Magazine, we are proud to live by a strong set of values and strive to "Engage and Delight – One Customer at a Time." Guided by our values— **Own It, Commit to Excellence, Be Agile, Speak Up, and Better Together.** We are a diverse team driven by integrity, accountability, and a commitment to exceptional results. We embrace change, prioritize continuous learning, and foster collaboration, transparency, and healthy debate. Together, we set each other up for success to achieve enterprise-wide goals.

**What You Gain:**

* Competitive compensation and benefits program with no waiting period – you’re eligible from your first day!
* 401(k) program with 5% employer match and 100% vesting as soon as you enroll.
* Comprehensive paid time off opportunities, including immediate access to four weeks of vacation, five sick days, parental leave and 11 company holidays (including two floating holidays).
* Leaders who are invested in supporting your accelerated career growth, plus paid training, tuition reimbursement and a robust educational platform – DevelopU – with more than 10,000 free courses to support you along the way.
* An inclusive working environment where you can build meaningful work relationships with a diverse group of professionals. Take advantage of opportunities to build on our team-oriented culture, such as joining one of our Employee Resource Groups.
* Access to our wellness and employee assistance programs.

**Job Description:**

***About the Role:***

 

We are seeking a Plant Manager for our Cambridge, MD, facility, a leading manufacturer of quality aseptic products. This role is responsible for providing overall leadership and accountability for plant operations with a strong focus on delivering results. In partnership with the site leadership team, the Plant Manager will drive employee engagement, safety, quality, customer service, continuous improvement, cost management, and production performance to meet or exceed business objectives. The successful candidate will identify and implement strategic opportunities to improve operational efficiency, safety, throughput, productivity, schedule attainment, cost reduction, and product quality while fostering a positive and high-performing work environment.

 

***You will add value to this role by performing various functions including, but not limited to:***

* Providing coaching and leadership to team members in the areas of employee engagement, safety, quality, customer service, continuous improvement, cost, and equipment reliability to elevate the team’s performance.
* Promoting a safety culture and ensuring adherence to all health and safety policies/protocols.
* Leading the development, execution, and monitoring of the operations strategy in line with the overall operational objectives to achieve safety, quality and performance improvement and ensure achievement of manufacturing goals.
* Leading the continuous improvement program to deliver opportunities in cost, quality, food safety and service.
* Utilizing available data including OEE, line speed target, and efficiency and process data to continuously improve productivity, uptime, and reliability.
* Coordinating manufacturing activities with all other functions of the organization and suppliers to obtain optimum production and utilization of human resources, machines, and equipment.
Contribute to the development and execution of strategic plant-wide initiatives. 

 

***Important Details:***

* This is a full-time, on-site role on first shift. Occasional flexibility is required to support alternate shifts.
The anticipated compensation for this position ranges from $154,700.00 - 232,100.00 USD annually. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics and business or organizational needs. For certain roles, the successful candidate may be eligible for annual discretionary merit compensation award, bonus and equity pay. 

 

***You’ll fit right in if you have:***

* High school diploma or equivalent is required; Bachelor's degree in manufacturing, industrial technology, or related field is preferred.
* Minimum of five years of leadership experience in a production or food manufacturing environment.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Experience leading in a union environment is preferred.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing Principles.
* Knowledge of safety regulations, quality control procedures, and inventory management.
* Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office. 

**Your TreeHouse Foods Career is Just a Click Away!**

Click on the “Apply” button or go directly to www.treehousefoods.com/careers to let us know you’re ready to join our team!

*At TreeHouse Foods, we embrace diversity and inclusion for innovation and growth. We are committed to building inclusive teams and an equitable workplace for our employees to bring their true selves to work to help us “Engage and Delight – One Customer at a Time”.* *TreeHouse Foods is an Equal Opportunity Employer that prohibits discrimination or harassment of any type. new_roles.description:
**Posting End Date:**

November 19, 2026

**Employee Type:**

Regular-Full time

**Union/Non:**

This is a non-union position

As Plant Manager at the Easter location, you will play a pivotal leadership role in ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Enbridge’s Easter Wind facility. As the senior Enbridge representative on site, you will be accountable for the overall performance of the plant, balancing operational excellence with a strong commitment to safety, environmental stewardship, and regulatory compliance. You will lead day-to-day operations while fostering a positive, inclusive, and safety-first culture aligned with Enbridge’s values and expectations.

 

In this role, you will work collaboratively with internal teams, contractors, service providers, and community stakeholders to deliver strong operational and financial results. You will provide hands-on leadership across operations, maintenance, asset integrity, and compliance, while maintaining financial discipline and transparency. If you are an experienced leader who thrives in a dynamic operational environment, values continuous improvement, and takes pride in enabling reliable renewable energy production, apply today. #joinourteam

 

**What You Will Do**

* Lead safe and reliable operations by managing all operational and maintenance activities for wind turbines and Balance of Plant (BOP) assets, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., NERC, CIP, FAA) and Enbridge safety standards.

* Champion a strong safety culture by ensuring adherence to safety policies and procedures, overseeing contractor and partner performance, and ensuring timely and accurate reporting and investigation of safety incidents and metrics.

* Manage people and contractors on site, including daily supervision, site orientations, performance oversight, and effective engagement with service providers, landowners, and internal stakeholders.

* Execute asset maintenance and integrity plans, ensuring all preventive, corrective, and major maintenance activities are planned, scheduled, tracked, and completed to Enbridge standards using systems such as MAXIMO.

* Oversee compliance and operational excellence, conducting audits, monitoring performance, managing lost production, and proactively addressing operational issues in collaboration with operations, engineering, and asset management teams.

* Drive financial performance and accountability by developing and managing the facility’s budget, forecasts, P&L reporting, explaining variances, managing procurement and work orders, and identifying opportunities for cost optimization and efficiency.

Provide clear reporting and leadership visibility, delivering accurate facility performance, safety, environmental, and financial reporting, and representing Enbridge as a trusted, responsible partner in the operation of the facility. 

 

**What you bring:**

* Related university degree and seven-plus years’ experience OR nine ‐ plus years of previous field operations experience, OR equivalent mix of formal education and experience.

* Valid Driver’s License and ability to obtain a Passport.

* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience including 3 years in a supervisory or management role.

* Strong electrical systems knowledge preferred, with ability to troubleshoot SCADA, substations, collection systems, and met towers; wind generation plant experience considered an asset.

* Demonstrated commitment to safety, ability to perform calmly under pressure, and strong problem‑solving and decision‑making capability.

* Proven people leadership, contract administration experience, and ability to build effective relationships with employees, contractors, landowners, municipalities, and community stakeholders.

Strong communication and integrity, customer-focused mindset, willingness to learn Enbridge systems and processes, and digital proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel) and Oracle. 

 

**Working Conditions:**

* This role will require being on-call (24/7) to respond to emergencies and/or maintenance needs of the site (on a pre-determined, scheduled basis).

* Plant Manager must reside within 75 miles of the site due to on-call requirements.

Travel may be required from time to time both within the United States and Canada (approximately 10-20%) 

 

The successful candidate will undergo various background screening that includes but is not limited to a 5-year driving record, criminal check, a company sponsored medical and drug testing.

 

**Physical Requirements:**

Must meet requirements of fit for work which includes, but is not limited to, demonstrating hand, arm, back and leg coordination needed to ascend and descend a wind tower and comply with a weight restriction of 132 kg (or 290lb) total climbing weight. Comfort with completing physically demanding tasks in all weather conditions and comfort working in enclosed spaces and at heights of 300 ft. Employee understands that these requirements may be modified at the Company's discretion.

Grasping, kneeling, light – moderate lifting (objects up to 45 pounds), reaching above shoulder, repetitive motion, sitting, standing, visual requirement (able to see screens, detect color coding, read fine print), hearing requirement.

 

**Mental Requirements:**

Ability to: understand, remember and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information, understand sophisticated problems and collaborate/explore alternative solutions, organize thoughts and ideas into understandable terminology, coordinate and prioritize work schedule on a short-term basis, make decisions which have moderate impact on the immediate work unit and monitor impact outside this area, understand and follow basic instructions and guidelines, complete routine forms, compose letters, outlines, memoranda and basic reports and connect with individuals via telephone.

 

**Base Salary:**

* Base salary ranges from $120,000 – $135,000 USD for US locations based upon candidate’s experience, skills, and internal equity.

Applicable compensation policies and guidelines apply to internal candidates. 

 

**Benefits:**

* A flexible benefits program that allows each employee to select the level of coverage needed for their family in the areas of health, dental, insurance, and disability.

* A paid maternity and parental leave benefit that offers up to 20 weeks of paid leave for birth-giving parents and up to 12 weeks for other eligible parents, providing flexibility and support during this important life event.

* Valuable retirement savings plans, including a savings plan with company stock as an investment option.

* Paid time off/vacation/sick, plus paid personal days off (depending on location), and paid holidays.

* An Employee and Family Assistance Program.

A Wellness Program, which focuses on supporting healthier employees by providing tools, resources, and opportunities to improve physical, mental, social, and financial well-being. 

 

***Company paid international relocation assistance is not offered for this role.***

Location:

Horsham, PA, US, 19044

Business Unit: Sensor, Test & Calibration

Posting Date: Nov 6, 2026

Job Description:

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading all daily operations of the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, high-quality, and cost-effective production. This role oversees production, safety, quality, maintenance, shipping, warehousing, staffing, budgeting, and continuous improvement while supporting company goals, customer requirements, and regulatory compliance.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:**

Facility & Maintenance

* Responsible for leading maintenance, facilities upkeep, asset reliability, and repair operations within plant.
* Respond to emergency repair situations and provide leadership for urgent maintenance needs, including factory visits when required.
* Ensures that production equipment, building systems, utilities, and facility infrastructure operate safely, efficiently, and reliably.
* Oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs for production equipment, heavy machinery, manufacturing utilities, and facility systems.
* Develop and manage maintenance schedules to reduce machine downtime, improve reliability, and extend equipment life.
* Inspect facilities, equipment, and infrastructure regularly to identify issues early and ensure timely corrective action.
* Coordinate repair and maintenance projects involving mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, fire suppression, security, lifts, cranes, and general building systems.
* Implement and enforce workplace safety policies and standards, including electrical safety, lockout/tagout, fire safety, hot work, and related compliance requirements.
* Lead root-cause analysis investigations for equipment failures and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Supervise mechanical and electrical technicians, assign work, monitor performance, and support training and skill development.
* Source, coordinate, and oversee external contractors and vendors, including service-level agreements and project execution.

Operational Leadership:

* Direct and manage daily plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality, shipping, warehousing, and support functions.
* Ensure production schedules, shipment commitments, and customer requirements are met safely, efficiently, and on time.
* Enforce company safety policies, OSHA requirements, environmental procedures, and regulatory standards to maintain a safe workplace.
* Lead, coach, train, and develop employees/ team while promoting accountability, teamwork, and employee engagement.
* Manage labor, materials, equipment, and operating expenses to meet cost, productivity, and business objectives.
* Support operational planning, capital improvement recommendations, staffing plans, and business growth initiatives.
 

**EXPERIENCE/REQUIREMENTS:**

Essential Skills

* Strong leadership, coaching, and team-building abilities.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, safety, quality, maintenance, inventory, and shipping processes.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Sound judgment, problem-solving ability, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to analyze operational data, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced production environment.
* Commitment to safety, quality, accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Performance Expectations

* Meet or exceed safety, quality, production, shipment, cost, and productivity targets.
* Maintain a safe, organized, compliant, and efficient manufacturing environment.
* Improve operational performance through effective leadership, problem solving, and continuous improvement.
* Develop employees to strengthen plant capability and succession planning.
* Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, employee engagement, and customer focus.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree, Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent manufacturing leadership experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive leadership experience in a manufacturing, production, or industrial environment.
* Experience leading hourly employees, and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing safety, quality, production performance, budgets, staffing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Working knowledge of OSHA, environmental, quality, and workplace safety requirements.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with ERP systems preferred.
 

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout a manufacturing facility for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull materials or equipment as required by plant operations.
* Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with noise, moving equipment, varying temperatures, and standard safety requirements.
* Ability to use personal protective equipment as required.
* Ability to climb stairs, bend, reach, and visually inspect production areas, equipment, and workstations.
