The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality Engineering is responsible for leading manufacturing quality across two Entegris manufacturing sites in Texas and translating global quality standards and quality priorities into consistent site execution. This role provides multi-site leadership to reduce risk, strengthen process capability, improve customer satisfaction, and deliver measurable quality improvements across the two-site footprint.  
  
The Senior Manager partners with site Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Development, Customer Quality, Product Quality and Quality Systems teams to embed quality ownership into daily operations. This leader is accountable for site quality performance, consistent implementation of quality standards, compliance with applicable regulatory, industry, and customer requirements, and the development of capable site quality teams. The role leads through site quality leaders and teams, establishes clear ownership and follow-through, and escalates risks and resource needs to North America quality leadership.

The hired individual will work on-site at our Burnet, TX location with some travel to our Decatur, TX location.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Translate global quality standards and quality priorities into coordinated execution plans for the two Texas sites, with clear owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead manufacturing quality across all two sites through site quality leaders and teams; clarify responsibilities, prioritize resources based on risk, and maintain regular on-site engagement.
* Ensure consistent implementation of global quality standards, policies, procedures, and best practices; maintain audit readiness and timely closure of findings at each site.
* Partner with site Operations leaders to establish quality roadmaps, objectives, and common key performance indicators (KPIs); conduct routine cross-site reviews and drive recovery plans where performance falls short.
* Own quality improvement plans that reduce defects, scrap, rework, cost of poor quality (COPQ), customer complaints, and manufacturing escapes, with site-level accountability for results.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve process capability, product conformity, yield, and manufacturing performance through effective process controls and proactive risk management.
* Lead targeted continuous improvement and change implementation across the two sites; standardize effective practices and verify that improvements are sustained.
* Ensure timely containment, disciplined root cause analysis, corrective/preventive action, and effectiveness verification for significant quality issues; deploy lessons learned across all two sites.
* Ensure practical, sustained application of SPC, MSA, FMEA, control plans, APQP, PPAP, 8D, A3, and DMAIC methodologies, as applicable to site processes and customer requirements.
* Serve as the quality escalation leader for the two Texas sites; communicate risk, containment status, recovery plans, and decisions needed, and escalate significant issues to Quality leadership.

* Develop site quality leaders and teams through coaching, clear expectations, technical capability building, and succession planning; identify staffing and resource needs across the two sites.
* Foster shared quality ownership across functions, reinforce accountability for commitments, and promote collaboration and continuous improvement across the two sites.
* Travel requirements will be a minimum of 25%, including regular presence across the two Texas sites.

**WHAT WE SEEK**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related field required.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing quality, including leadership responsibility for quality teams and manufacturing quality outcomes.
* 5+ years of quality management experience, with demonstrated ability to lead through site leaders or cross-functional teams; multi-site leadership experience preferred.
* Demonstrated success implementing quality systems and delivering sustained improvements in manufacturing quality, process capability, and cost of poor quality.

protected_roles.description:
Apnimed is a rapidly growing pharmaceutical company working to transform the treatment of sleep apnea based on a simple idea – patients with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) could benefit from treatment with a safe and effective oral medication dosed once daily at bedtime. Our lead development program, AD109, targets the neurologic control of upper airway muscles to maintain an open airway during sleep. Apnimed is committed to innovation, as well as state-of-the-art advancements in sleep medicine, which is leading to the development of a portfolio of novel pharmacologic therapies for sleep apnea and related disorders.

Recognized by the Boston Business Journal as one of the Best Places to Work in both 2024 and 2025, we are continuing to grow and build the foundational operations that enable our employees and our mission to thrive.

**Summary**:

The Senior Manager, Quality Systems & Compliance reports to the Senior Director, GCP Quality Assurance and Quality Compliance and is responsible for administering, maintaining, and continuously improving Apnimed's electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) and associated quality processes, and for keeping them inspection-ready. The successful candidate will also play a key role in strengthening the Quality Management System infrastructure as a business partner across GxP and corporate quality functions, ensuring quality processes remain compliant, scalable, and aligned with the company's transition toward commercialization. This is an exciting opportunity to strengthen the quality infrastructure that supports Apnimed as part of a major paradigm shift in the treatment of sleep apnea from medical devices and surgery to a first in class pharmaceutical treatment.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $170,000.00 to $190,000.00. Final compensation will depend on the selected candidate’s level, education and relevant experience.

### **Key Job Duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Serve as subject matter expert and administrator for the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS), evaluating proposed system changes and coordinating testing, validation, and deployment activities.
* Support the integration of new business processes, departments, and vendors into the Quality Management System, and oversee onboarding, knowledge transfer, and competency requirements for new eQMS administrators.
* Maintain system documentation, including procedures, work instructions, validation documentation, and configuration records.
* Administer the training program: confirm assignments and curricula reflect quality system responsibilities, manage role-based eQMS training and user support, and maintain a centralized library of user guidance, job aids, and FAQs.
* Provide oversight and support for core quality processes, including document control, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, investigations, supplier quality records, and training management.
* Manage vendor governance activities and periodic performance reviews, ensuring reviews are completed and properly documented and filed.
* Keep quality systems and records in a state of continuous inspection readiness; support regulatory inspections and audits through preparation of records, reports, metrics, and system demonstrations; and monitor industry trends and regulatory expectations.
* Present quality system performance trends and recommendations to Quality leadership, lead or support continuous improvement initiatives, and collaborate cross-functionally to standardize quality processes across departments.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a scientific, technical, engineering, quality, or related discipline.
* 8+ years of Quality Assurance, Quality Systems, or Quality Management experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry, including:
* Demonstrated experience managing electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), including administering or supporting platforms such as Dot Compliance, Veeva Quality, MasterControl, TrackWise Digital, ComplianceWire, or similar.
* Working knowledge of FDA, EMA, ICH, GCP, GMP, and GLP requirements.
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections and external/internal audits.
* Preferred: Direct administrator experience with Veeva Quality, and experience with computerized system validation (CSV) and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
* Preferred: Experience supporting both development-stage and commercial pharmaceutical operations, and implementing or enhancing eQMS platforms.
* Ability to manage simultaneous priorities and changing deadlines.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
* Proficiency in the use of MS Word, PowerPoint; experience with Adobe Acrobat Professional.

  
**Benefits**  

* 401(k) with company match
* Generous time off for vacation
* Generous healthcare benefits
* Flexible working environment
* Motivated and experienced team
* Winner of 2024 and 2025 Boston Business Journal Best Places to Work

### **Location and Other Information:**

* Apnimed is a publicly licensed company based in Cambridge, MA; we are generally virtual and specific location within the US is not critical.
* We are a small growing Company with an inclusive environment.
* Must be able to travel as necessary.
* Apnimed is an EEO employer committed to an exciting, diverse, and enriching work environment.
* Please visit us at www.apnimed.com to learn more about our work with Obstructive Sleep Apnea.

**Company Description**

With over $2B in revenue, 80+ manufacturing facilities across 6 continents and over 9,000 employees worldwide, Signode is a leading manufacturer of a broad spectrum of transit packaging consumables, tools, software, and equipment that optimize end-of-line packaging operations and protect products in transit. Signode brings this extensive product portfolio together under hundreds of trusted brands to offer complete transit packaging solutions to its customers.  
  
We produce strap, stretch and protective packaging. We also manufacture packaging tools and equipment used to apply the bulk packaging materials. These commercial packaging products are used to pack, bundle, unitize, protect, and secure goods during warehousing and transit. Our company is a pioneer in the industrial packaging sector with a long history of customer-focused innovations in materials, processes and automation technology that have revolutionized the sector.  
  
Headquartered in Tampa, Florida, we are proud to be the Transit Packaging Division of Crown Holdings, Inc. We are excited to go to market as Signode and to share the portfolio of products, services and capabilities that make us the world’s premier end-of-line packaging company.

 **Job Description**

**Benefits:**

Signode offers a comprehensive benefits package to full-time employees, which includes health, dental, vision, 401k, paid time off, life insurance, wellness perks, and more. Benefits begin the month following the hire date.

**Summary**

This role is for a Plant Manager who is a true leader, one who can build a strong, positive culture throughout the plant. The position calls for a sharp operational and analytical mind that constantly seeks out, teaches, and leads improvements in Safety Performance, Cost Control, Standardized Processes (LEAN), Production Reporting, and Inventory Control.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to lead one of Signode’s most important locations, having a big impact on our ability to deliver a profitable year. Here is what makes this role stand out:

* Pilot the company’s Operational Excellence system, delivering a glidepath in Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, Output, and Morale.
* Take charge of a major turnaround facility. The right leader is confident yet humble, ready to run a 24/7 site from the bottom up, and understands the sweat and equity required to turn it around.
* Succeed here, and fast-track your path to the next level.

**Essential Functions**

* Directly manage and coordinate the activities of various plant departments and sites within Signode.
* Provide strong leadership to the manufacturing team, fostering a collaborative and results-oriented work environment.

* Communicate, uphold and enforce safety protocols and regulatory compliance to maintain a safe and secure working environment.
* Responsible for talent management and employee lifecycle activities, from hiring to terminating.

* Lead and support initiatives for continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to enhance plant processes, reduce waste, and increase overall efficiency.

protected_roles.title: Quality Director
protected_roles.description:
At Oceans Behavioral Hospital Longview, healing is our focus. We are passionate about helping adults and seniors manage the challenges associated with anxiety, depression and other mental health issues. Utilizing proven, innovative and progressive therapies, our qualified professionals strive to promote long-term wellness through a range of inpatient and outpatient psychiatric counseling and treatment options.

The Director, Quality and Patient Safety plans, develops, implements and manages comprehensive and effective systems to monitor and evaluate the quality and appropriateness of patient services and programs in support of the organizational mission and goals. This position will work closely under the supervision of the Hospital CEO, functions as a support person in the coordination and organization of administrative processes in a high quality efficient and cost-effective manner. All duties to be done in accordance with Joint Commission, Federal and State regulations, Oceans’ Mission, policies and procedures and quality standards.

  

**Essential Functions:**

* Works with VP, Quality and Patient Safety implementing organization-wide quality programs at the hospital level.

* Facilitates the hospital Quality Assessment and Performance Improvement (QAPI) committee.

* Prepares an annual evaluation of the hospital QAPI plan, including process and outcomes.

* Oversees hospital-wide performance improvement (PI) projects identified through on-going data driven quality assessment.

* Coordinates the hospital’s data collection procedures and provides on-going support and education to staff regarding QAPI tools and reporting requirements; utilizes data and collaborates with leadership to set priorities and provide guidance in their development of quality improvement work plans.

* Serves as a resource to the medical staff, administrators and other staff including participation in root cause analyses, as indicated, to investigate potentially avoidable sentinel events.

* Completes assignments accurately, in a timely manner and within procedural guidelines.

* Coordinates education for QAPI principles and regulatory standards as indicated. Conducts training for staff.

* Participates in Joint Commission Accreditation process including plan of action tracking and completion.

* Performs other duties and projects as assigned by the facility administrator and corporate office.

**Requirements**

**Education / Experience:**

* Associate degree or RN diploma required.
* Healthcare experience related to clinical leadership and/or quality assessment and performance improvement.
* Behavioral health experience preferred.

**Qualifications / Skills:**

* Demonstrates proficient computer skills with MS office products and electronic QAPI software solutions.
* Ability to create and provide training programs on related quality performance topics.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and simultaneously manage multiple projects.
* Knowledge of state and federal regulatory requirements, Joint Commission Accreditation.
* CPHQ certification preferred.
* Must successfully complete CPR certification and an Oceans approved behavioral health de-escalation program.

**Work Environment:**

Subject to many interruptions. Occasional pressure due to multiple calls and inquiries. This position can be high paced and stressful; must be able to cope mentally and physically to atmosphere. Work requires spending approximately 90% or more of the time inside a building that offers protection from weather conditions but not necessarily from temperature changes.
